name: GitHub

findings.api_breadth: Broad repositories, files, issues, pull requests, workflows and permitted security/account operations. The official operational MCP has both remote and local forms; it is not merely documentation search.

evidence.title: Authenticating to the REST API
evidence.excerpt: GitHub documents PATs, GitHub App tokens, OAuth app tokens and workflow GITHUB_TOKEN; endpoint permissions govern access.

evidence.title: Forming calls with GraphQL
evidence.excerpt: GraphQL accepts PATs, GitHub Apps or OAuth apps, with scopes/permissions for requested resources.

evidence.title: GitHub official MCP Server
evidence.excerpt: The GitHub-owned repository documents a vendor-hosted remote MCP plus a local implementation, OAuth/PAT access, and operational repository, issue, PR and workflow tools.

evidence.title: Managing your personal access tokens
evidence.excerpt: Users self-create scoped tokens; organizations may block or require approval for fine-grained tokens, which remain public-read-only pending approval.

evidence.title: GitHub plans and pricing
evidence.excerpt: A free account includes core repository collaboration and GitHub Apps; premium resources/features have separate entitlements.

notes: Independently researched from seeds without reading first_pass or worker research. Build_now refers to ordinary authorized core API/local-MCP development; organization policy, SSO, endpoint scope and premium features remain conditional. Remote MCP requires a suitable host and policies, and custom OAuth hosts need an app; PAT is also documented. No account or API execution.

name: Vercel

auth_methods: OAuth/integration code exchange for scoped REST access
findings.api_breadth: Broad deployment, project, environment-variable, domain/DNS, team, storage, webhook and account APIs. Official MCP searches docs and manages project/deployment/log resources; public tools and authenticated tools are distinct.

evidence.title: Vercel REST API Reference
evidence.excerpt: The REST API accepts bearer access tokens created in account settings and covers deployments, projects, domains, environment settings and many other resources.

evidence.title: Building Integrations with Vercel REST API
evidence.excerpt: An integration exchanges a short-lived code using client credentials for a scoped API access token; team resources use the installation's team identifier.

evidence.title: Use Vercel's MCP server
evidence.excerpt: Vercel hosts an OAuth MCP with public and authenticated tools. A custom client may connect without review using a Client ID Metadata Document; approved-client review is another path.

evidence.title: Vercel Pricing
evidence.excerpt: Vercel provides a $0 Hobby plan, paid Pro/Enterprise tiers, and a Pro trial.

notes: Independently recorded before first_pass comparison. The opened current MCP page adds CIMD support, so the older search excerpt saying all clients need vendor review was rejected. I did not label MCP beta because that wording was absent from the current opened page. Team/user permissions and plan/usage limits still apply; a generic build does not require a universal partner or client-review gate. No authenticated execution.

name: Coda

auth_methods: Official MCP OAuth 2 for supported clients
Official MCP personal access token with MCP restriction and read/write scope
findings.api_breadth: REST supports documents, pages, tables, rows, formulas/controls and sharing. Official MCP can read and write Coda docs, with role- and plan-dependent access; it is operational rather than documentation-only.

evidence.title: Coda/Superhuman Docs API v1 Reference
evidence.excerpt: The official indexed reference documents bearer-authorized page and table/row operations; page creation and some updates require Doc Maker permissions.

evidence.title: Coda API - vendor Postman workspace
evidence.excerpt: The vendor workspace describes the REST API for docs, pages, tables and rows and states it is free for users in free and paid workspaces.

evidence.title: Connect to the Coda MCP
evidence.excerpt: Coda documents OAuth or MCP-scoped PAT connections. Paid Doc Makers get the full MCP; free Doc Makers get all tools within 30 weekly/60 monthly requests, while Editors get read tools only.

notes: Independently recorded before comparison. The Coda developer URL redirected to inaccessible docs.superhuman.com, so exact core-API details used official indexed content and the opened vendor Postman introduction, while MCP auth/role/plan rules came from the fully opened Coda help article. Coda MCP is explicitly beta. Free Doc Makers are not restricted to read-only MCP; Editors are. Admin API entitlement was not generalized from the ordinary document API. No credentials created.

name: Smartsheet

auth_methods: API access token as Bearer for direct/machine integrations
Official MCP uses an API token or supported OAuth client
findings.api_breadth: Broad sheets/rows, folders, users, reports and other organizational resources through the public API. The vendor MCP performs permitted resource operations through OAuth-scoped tools and is not documentation-only.

evidence.title: Smartsheet API introduction
evidence.excerpt: The current introduction requires Business, Enterprise or Advanced Work Management and documents resource schemas and API operations.

evidence.title: Smartsheet API Authentication
evidence.excerpt: Direct integrations use bearer access tokens; user-consent integrations can use Smartsheet OAuth2. Regions/Gov have separate tokens.

evidence.title: Developer Tools Registration
evidence.excerpt: Current developer registration requires an existing licensed Smartsheet user on Business or higher; registration is for user-authorized applications, not required for direct-token use.

evidence.title: Smartsheet free trial FAQ
evidence.excerpt: The ordinary Business trial is free, but explicitly cannot generate API access tokens; paid Business/Enterprise is the documented upgrade route.

evidence.title: Smartsheet MCP Server overview
evidence.excerpt: External MCP-enabled AI tools require Business, Enterprise or Advanced Work Management; the lower Pro entitlement for in-product Smart Assist is distinct.

evidence.title: Install the Smartsheet MCP server
evidence.excerpt: Smartsheet publishes regional production MCP URLs and accepts a valid API token or supported OAuth client.

notes: Independently recorded before comparison. An older Smartsheet blog mentions a sandbox developer registration route, but its actual current registration link explicitly requires a licensed Business-or-higher user. The ordinary free trial's Business label does not establish self-issuable API credentials. OAuth does not eliminate the documented plan eligibility. No signup or API execution.

name: Plaid

auth_methods: client_id and environment secret in JSON body or Plaid headers
Dashboard MCP OAuth client_credentials token with mcp:dashboard scope
findings.api_breadth: Broad financial-data/product APIs. Local AI-coding/Sandbox MCP provides mock data, sandbox tokens, documentation search and webhook simulation; hosted Dashboard MCP provides production diagnostics/Link/usage analytics, not an unrestricted consumer-financial-data connector.

evidence.title: Plaid API overview
evidence.excerpt: Plaid issues client ID/secret through Dashboard signup; most endpoints use these credentials. The API is JSON HTTPS POST; Sandbox and requested Production access are separate.

evidence.title: Plaid Sandbox overview
evidence.excerpt: Sandbox supports fake-data development and a local MCP. New teams from April 15, 2026 can use free live-data Trial plans in the US/Canada, with limits and product eligibility.

evidence.title: Plaid Dashboard MCP server
evidence.excerpt: Plaid distinguishes its local development MCP from hosted Dashboard diagnostics. Dashboard MCP requires Production approval for at least one product and OAuth client_credentials with mcp:dashboard.

notes: Independently recorded before comparison. partner_sales represents the vendor production-access approval gate, not a claim that all Sandbox development needs outreach. Limited Production is deprecated for new teams in favor of US/Canada Trial plans. Dashboard MCP and sandbox/documentation tooling have different scope and eligibility. Production access and regional/product restrictions remain necessary. No account or live financial API was accessed.
